answer_2.quote: We compute accuracy (% of solved puzzles) for these models. We also report pass@k scores and error rates for path violations.

answer_4.quote: We used six annotators (aged 22-27, with CS backgrounds) to solve 100 i.i.d. drawn puzzles... a puzzle is marked as solved if the majority found a correct solution.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators solve each puzzle and a majority vote determines whether the solution is correct.
